messages.text: Sale secures Grand Final title and Brown crowned Road to Mallorca No 1

metadata.summary: Julien Sale produced a dominant final round to secure victory at the HotelPlanner Tour’s Grand Final, while Hamish Brown topped the Road to Mallorca rankings.
metadata.content: HotelPlanner Tour Grand Final: Julien Sale secures title, Hamish Brown crowned Road to Mallorca No 1 and DP World Tour cards confirmed | Golf News | Sky Sports Skip to main content HotelPlanner Tour Grand Final: Julien Sale secures title, Hamish Brown crowned Road to Mallorca No 1 and DP World Tour cards confirmed HotelPlanner Tour Grand Final sees France's Julien Sale claim title and Denmark's Hamish Brown finish top of the Road to Mallorca Rankings; Sale ends year second in rankings and will now step up to golf's DP World Tour for the first time in his career Sunday 1 November 2026 19:06, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Highlights from day four of the HotelPlanner Tour Grand Final at the Club de Golf Alcanada in Mallorca, Spain Julien Sale produced a dominant final round to secure victory at the HotelPlanner Tour’s Grand Final, while Hamish Brown topped the Road to Mallorca rankings. Frenchman Sale, who was guaranteed promotion to the DP World Tour before the season finale in Mallorca, posted his second 65 of the week to reach 22 under par, four strokes clear of the Brown, who narrowly held onto solo second to capture the season-long title. Sale ends the year second in the rankings and will now step up to golf's DP World Tour for the first time in his career. messages.text: Alcaraz waltzes past De Minaur to win Vienna title for first time

metadata.summary: Carlos Alcaraz won his fourth title of an injury-disrupted season as he defeated Alex de Minaur in the Erste Bank Open final in Vienna.
metadata.content: Carlos Alcaraz: Spaniard seals Erste Bank Open victory in Vienna as he defeats Alex de Minaur | Tennis News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Carlos Alcaraz: Spaniard seals Erste Bank Open victory in Vienna as he defeats Alex de Minaur Carlos Alcaraz picks up his fourth title of 2026 with 6-1 6-4 victory; world No 3 defeats Alex de Minaur for seventh match in a row; watch the ATP Paris Masters live on Sky Sports from Monday Sunday 1 November 2026 15:32, UK Image: Carlos Alcaraz beat Alex de Minaur to ‌win the Erste Bank Open in Vienna on Sunday Carlos Alcaraz won his fourth title of an injury-disrupted season as he defeated Alex de Minaur in the Erste Bank Open final in Vienna. The Spaniard, who missed five months of the year with a wrist issue, powered to a 6-1 6-4 win against world No 10 Minaur in the indoor hard-court event. World No 3 Alcaraz delivered a high-quality, 97-minute display to overwhelm De Minaur and secure the title without dropping a set across his five matches.
